pre_data_statement: Parameters below are round, domain-standard constants fixed from published conventions (Wilder 1978 ADX/DI period-14; textbook ADX 20 trend threshold; calendar-multiple SMA windows on the hourly UTC clock) BEFORE any history-wide statistic of the retrieved Vision series was computed or viewed. No label-optimization sweep was run. The +-1-notch sensitivity table is reported once, never iterated.
clock: UTC hourly bars. Bar k covers [open_k, open_k + 1h); close time = open_k + 1h. No DST exists for UTC.
pit_disclosure: Vision klines are retrospective exchange snapshots (retrieved 2026-09, no per-bar publication timestamps). Frozen PIT convention: a bar is knowable at its close; the first executable fill is at the NEXT bar open (>=1 executable-bar latency). Every decision uses only bars closed at or before decision time.

adx.name: Wilder ADX
adx.definition: Standard Wilder: TR = max(h-l, |h-c_prev|, |l-c_prev|); +DM = (h_t - h_{t-1}) iff > (l_{t-1} - l_t) and > 0 else 0; -DM = (l_{t-1} - l_t) iff > (h_t - h_{t-1}) and > 0 else 0; smoothed via Wilder recursion seeded with SMA of first 14 values; +DI = 100*sm(+DM)/sm(TR); -DI = 100*sm(-DM)/sm(TR); DX = 100*|+DI - -DI|/(+DI + -DI); ADX = Wilder RMA of DX seeded with SMA of first 14 DX values. TR == 0 => DX := 0 (documented degenerate-flat law).

sma_fast.role: declared structural observable; NOT used in base label logic and NOT notched (kept in freeze for completeness)

raw_label_law.order: evaluated top-down; first hit wins; total partition
rules: warmup: bar index t < warmup_bars(720) counted from the first retrieved bar => TRANSITION_UNKNOWN (insufficient evidence)
margin: ADX in the open interval (18.0, 22.0), i.e. |ADX - 20.0| < 2.0 => TRANSITION_UNKNOWN (boundary-uncertainty margin)
trend: ADX >= 22.0 and DI+ >= DI- => UPTREND; ADX >= 22.0 and DI- > DI+ => DOWNTREND (DI+ == DI- exactly resolves to UPTREND by the frozen >= tie rule)
range: ADX <= 18.0 and close >= SMA720 => DISTRIBUTION; ADX <= 18.0 and close < SMA720 => ACCUMULATION (close == SMA720 exactly resolves to DISTRIBUTION by the frozen >= tie rule)
raw_label_law.causality: all inputs at bar t use bars with close time <= close(t); no model, no abstention, no LLM

state_machine_law.name: transition buffer with hysteresis
state_machine_law.definition: state starts TRANSITION_UNKNOWN. Maintain pending=(label,count). If raw(t) == state: pending reset, state unchanged. If raw(t) != state: if raw(t) == pending.label then count += 1 else pending = (raw(t), 1); when count reaches transition_buffer(24), state := raw(t). TRANSITION_UNKNOWN raw labels obey the identical 24-bar persistence law (no special casing).
state_machine_law.consequences: state min-dwell is 24 bars (1 day) by construction; sub-buffer label noise is absorbed as the incumbent phase (this is the explicit no-op law backbone for churn control)

sensitivity_table_contract.law: Single +-1-notch variants of the three decision knobs, each computed ONCE against the frozen base on the full post-warmup retrieved series; agreement = fraction of post-warmup bars with identical STATE label. This table is reported, never optimized against; no parameter may be re-chosen after seeing it.

adx_trend_threshold.note: margin band stays thr-2..thr+2 relative to the notched threshold

self_check_plan7: Named mechanism classes this rule could be accused of: none. The rule is a plain trend-strength/range partition (ADX/DI + SMA anchor); it is not a reversal, imbalance, illiquidity, OI, vol-shock or pair-spread signal and it is not any RSM-V1 specialist (those are strategies, not phase rules). Phase rules are per-cell code-owned by plan sec5 and the V2 Jev labels are not read.
